panels.description: Director Cassian Lock approaches Alex in the registry hall, examining the record before looking at Alex. Keep the upper registry clear.
Three House emblems—Caldera, Vector and Orbital—divide the registry screen behind Lock. Keep the upper screen clear.
Alex and Lock face one another across the registry terminal. Keep the upper terminal clear.
Alex closes the registry and Lock taps the display, freezing the estate. Keep the upper display clear.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: Assign the estate to House administration. Your debt clears. Halyard access becomes permanent.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: Refuse, and immediate commercial rights freeze pending review.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: You’re asking me to sell work I didn’t make.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: I’m offering scale, employment and a clean account.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: Then find the people who made it.
